title: Borrowing Record Bonus on the Pocketwire Advance Room — Training Note
content:
When at least 4 advances were disbursed on the Pocketwire Advance line in the twelve months before the handling date, 20.00 is added to the room for a new advance; when at least 2 but fewer than 4 advances were disbursed on it in that window, 10.00 is added to the room; fewer advances add nothing to the room.

## Questions answered

**What is the window?** A window of twelve months before the handling date covers the records dated after the same day of the month twelve months before the handling date, up to and including the handling date. With a hypothetical handling date of 25 September, it covers advances disbursed after 25 September of the previous year up to and including 25 September.

**What is counted?** The advances disbursed on the line whose disbursement date falls in that window. Every such advance counts, whether it has since been repaid or not.

**What does each count add?**

| Advances disbursed in the window | Added to the room |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 20.00 |
| 2 or 3 | 10.00 |
| 0 or 1 | Nothing |

**Where are the boundaries?** 4 advances add 20.00 and 3 add 10.00; 2 advances add 10.00 and 1 adds nothing.

**Does an advance disbursed fourteen months ago count?** No; it is dated outside the twelve-month window.
